# cachyos-extras — the CachyOS host-parity workstation toolset

## Candy Properties

| Property | Value |
|----------|-------|
| Distro | Arch/CachyOS (`pac` + AUR) |
| Requires | `@github.com/opencharly/layer-yay` (AUR helper) |
| Scope | host workstation tools (no hardware/boot/firmware/network) |

## What it installs

The CachyOS netinstall + manual-install gap, reverse-resolved to top-level
packages: system/pacman tooling (`pacman-contrib`, `pkgfile`,
`rebuild-detector`, `paru`, `plocate`), diagnostics/monitors (`btop`,
`duf`, `glances`, `pv`), editors/terminal/apps (`micro`, `nano` + syntax,
`vim`, `alacritty`, `meld`, `firefox`), net/fs/mail (`inetutils`,
`nfs-utils`, `syncthing`, `s-nail`, `unrar`), desktop-integration
(`accountsservice`, `xdg-user-dirs`, `xdg-utils`, `python-defusedxml`,
`python-packaging`), and AUR (`cloudflared-bin`, `gvisor-tap-vsock`).
Host-hardware/boot/firmware/network entries are excluded by design.

## Usage

Compose it in a CachyOS workstation box:

```yaml
cachyos-workstation:
  candy:
    base: cachyos-base
    candy:
      - '@github.com/opencharly/layer-cachyos-extras:v2026.xxx.yyyy'
```

## Verification

`plan:` `check:` steps assert the headline binaries resolve on the built
image (`/usr/bin/btop`, `/usr/bin/duf`, `/usr/bin/paru`, `command -v
cloudflared`, `/usr/bin/syncthing`) and that `accountsservice` is installed.
